sentences.text: Today we will talk about Bangkok, the capital city of Thailand.
Part one, introduction.
Bangkok is the biggest city in Thailand.
It has more than 10 million people.
It is a busy, colorful, and exciting city.
Bangkok is known for its temples, street food, markets, and modern buildings.
It is a place where old traditions and new lifestyles come together.
Part two, location and weather.
Bangkok is in the central part of Thailand.
The city is next to the Chow Friar River.
The weather is usually hot and humid.
There are three main seasons, hot season, rainy season, cool season.
Even in the cool season, Bangkok is warm and sunny.
Part three, landmarks and temples.
Bangkok has many famous landmarks.
The most important is the Grand Palace.
It is a beautiful old palace with gold decorations, inside you can see the temple of the Emerald Buddha.
Another famous temple is Wat Aaron, also called the Temple of Dawn.
It is next to the river and looks very beautiful at sunset.
There is also Wat Pho, the temple of the reclining Buddha.
It has a huge golden Buddha statue that is 46 meters long.
Part four, markets and shopping.
Bangkok is famous for shopping.
You can go to big shopping malls like MBK Center or Siam Paragon.
You can also visit local street markets.
The most popular market is Chatuchak Weekend Market.
It has more than 8,000 stalls.
You can buy clothes, souvenirs, food, art and much more.
At night, Bangkok has many night markets.
They are full of lights, music and tasty street food.
Part five, food.
Food in Bangkok is very delicious.
You can eat in restaurants or on the street.
Street food is cheap and tasty.

Some popular dishes are Pad Thai, stir -fried noodles with egg, tofu, shrimp or chicken, tom yum soup, spicy and sour soup with shrimp, mango sticky rice, sweet rice with coconut milk and fresh mango.
You can also drink Thai iced tea or fresh coconut juice.
Part six, culture and lifestyle.
Bangkok is full of culture.
People are friendly and smile often.
Thailand is called the land of smiles.
In daily life, people visit temples, eat with family and enjoy street festivals.
Bangkok is also famous for tuk -tuks, three -wheeled taxis.
They are a fun way to travel around the city.
Part seven, festivals.
Bangkok celebrates many festivals.
One of the biggest is Songkran, the Thai New Year in April.
During Songkran, people splash water on each other in the streets.
It is a symbol of cleaning and new beginnings.
Another festival is Loi Krathong in November.
People put small floating baskets with candles on the river.
It looks very beautiful at night.
Fun facts, Bangkok's real name in Thai is very long.
It has 168 letters.
The city has more than 400 temples.
Bangkok has one of the busiest airports in Asia.
The city is also famous for its lively nightlife.
That is all for today.
Now you know many things about Bangkok, Thailand.
It is a city of temples, markets, food and festivals.
Thank you for listening to Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
